steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Inverse Proportion: X is inversely proportional to Y means X = k/Y, which is the same as X being proportional to 1/Y.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: y is inversely proportional to x. When x = 4, y = 15. Find y when x = 10. | P ∝ 1/Q. When Q = 6, P = 5. Find the constant k. | The time to paint a fence is inversely proportional to the number of painters. 3 painters take 8 hours. How long for 4 painters?
